features.title: Headless 3D and VFX engine
features.what: It renders scenes without a viewport or a timeline UI.
features.evidence_quote: vork, the Voyager rendering kernel, is a headless 3D and VFX engine built for agents.

features.title: Scenes are programs
features.what: A scene is written as code and rendered on the GPU.
features.evidence_quote: These are scenes written as code and rendered on a GPU. No video model required.

features.title: Look at the result, revise
features.what: The agent renders, inspects the image, then edits its own code.
features.evidence_quote: An agent writes a scene, renders it, looks at the result and revises the code. There is no editor to drive.

features.title: Shaders mid-shot
features.what: The agent can program a shader in the middle of a shot.
features.evidence_quote: An agent can also write a shader in the middle of a shot.

features.title: Simulation and VFX examples
features.what: The repo ships shots from million-agent simulations to VFX on real footage.
features.evidence_quote: A million birds, each steering itself over a lagoon. A black hole that bends light.

features.title: Research preview
features.what: The engine is a preview, source-available and free for now.
features.evidence_quote: Source-available and free during the research preview.

risks.text: It is a research preview, not a finished product.
It needs a GPU with Vulkan or Metal, and there is no editor UI to fall back on.
